title: NFCPS One faster Scripture Lens + Read books
notes: Scripture Lens now samples sermon playback every 2 seconds, surfaces common biblical themes locally for near-instant matches, keeps a rolling thought window for deeper semantic matching, shows the first KJV result immediately, and fills WEB/ASV comparisons afterward. It no longer automatically falls back to microphone speech recognition when playback capture is blocked, so Watch should not be interrupted by an unsolicited mic takeover. Read now uses a self-healing native shelf mount and includes Atomic Habits, Ikigai, Rework, Shoe Dog, Think Like a Monk, Limitless, Hooked, The Mountain Is You, The Alchemist, Poor Charlie's Almanack, The Art of Thinking Clearly, Can't Hurt Me, Think and Grow Rich and more, plus legal public-domain classics that open in the NFCPS reader.
